instruction.text: Use the table above to fill in the gaps and answer the questions.

atoms.a: What is the total amount of money that Adam spends?
What is the total number of items that Adam buys?

wrong.text: Add up all the numbers in the Quantity column.

hint.text: To calculate the mean here, divide the total amount of money that Adam spends by the total number of items that Adam buys.

wrong.text: Make sure to put the answers in pence rather than pounds.

end.text: The mean price per item of Adam’s shopping trip is 31p.
